ticket.title: Can't log in to the customer portal
articles: Hi, I forgot my password and can't log into the customer portal anymore. Can you help me get back in?
I already tried the normal login page but there's no obvious way to reset it myself.
Could you please confirm the email address on file for this account? I want to make sure the reset link actually goes somewhere I can still access.
Yes, that's the correct email address, it's the one I'm writing to you from right now.

knowledge_base_answers.title: Resetting your password
knowledge_base_answers.body: To reset your password, open the login page and click the 'Forgot password' link. Enter your email address and follow the reset link we send you to choose a new password.

knowledge_base_answers.title: Resetting your printer to factory defaults
knowledge_base_answers.body: If your printer stops responding to print jobs, you can reset it to factory defaults by holding the power button for 10 seconds while the printer is disconnected from the network.

knowledge_base_answers.title: Updating the billing address on your account
knowledge_base_answers.body: Your billing address is used for invoices and tax calculation and can be changed at any time from the account settings page under 'Billing details'. Enter the new address, save, and it will apply to every invoice generated from that point onward - past invoices are not retroactively changed. If your account is managed by an organization administrator, only that administrator can update the shared billing address.
